LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 MODAL AUXILIARIES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which words do we use to express requests, permission, ability and obligation?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify modal auxiliaries in a passage
2. use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods
3. value the importance of using modal auxiliaries in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 MODAL AUXILIARIES
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify modal auxiliaries in a passage
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. value the importance of using modal auxiliaries in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Modal Auxiliaries important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words do we use to express requests, permission, ability and obligation?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify modal auxiliaries in a passage
2. use modal auxiliaries in sentences to express different moods
3. value the importance of using modal auxiliaries in communication
